title: The email capture survived an erase until reload
evidence: PlanPdf.tsx useEmailCaptureState.reset() (startState) runs when usePlanView's shownErase moves; the box returns and the pulse stops (US-09 AC19, Brad 2026-11-10). Pinned by ResultsPanel.skip-gate.test.tsx "an erase resets the email capture"; reset() also releases the send claim (a per-send token), so a send pending at the erase can neither block the fresh box nor write its answer into it ("a send pending at the erase")
